sources.label: Bison Bank EUB MiCA White Paper (Sections D.1, E.2, E.3, F.2)

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Bison Bank's MiCA white paper states that EUB uses the Solana Token-2022 Program Account State feature orchestrated via Fireblocks, which supports either an allowlist (whitelist) or a denylist (blacklist), with the allowlist in active use to restrict receipt, holding, and transfers to bank-approved institutional partner wallets. The white paper further states that Bison Bank reserves the right to block wallets ('Blocked Wallets') and freeze EUB in holder wallets.
